typesetting_rules: Display font (Russo One) for dramatic rank banners, 'LEVEL AUFSTIEG!' title, and roman numeral accents
Outfit font for body copy, coin counters, and system labels
Maximum heading tracking: tracking-wide for neon banners, standard tracking for body
Line-height: tight for level headlines, relaxed for descriptions

entry_surfaces./: Neon Miami landing hero with interactive map explore CTA and live spot cards
entry_surfaces./profil: Gamer profile hub with Roman rank badge, smooth XP progress bar, coin counter, and modal LevelUpOverlay
entry_surfaces./einstellungen: Tactical settings list with language switch, privacy options, and version info

keyframe_rules: XP bar fills smoothly to 100% via cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)
Pink-violet neon ring pulses at scale 0.35 to 1.35 with outer glow
Roman numeral transition: old rank fades/glides up as new glowing rank locks in
Particle burst: 18 golden spark elements animated via CSS transform: translate3d and opacity
Coin coin-flip spin: CSS rotateY(360deg) loop during reward display
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: instantly show confirmed state with static neon framing

accessibility.reduced_motion: Supported via window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') and CSS overrides
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48px touch target for the 'Weiter' button and action controls

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure atomic server-side reward awarding of 500 Leonida Coins per level gained via level_coin_rewards ledger
Direct jump representation for multi-level jumps (e.g. I -> III with +1000 Leonida Coins)
Use GPU-accelerated CSS properties (transform, opacity) exclusively to maintain 60 FPS on iOS Capacitor and mobile browsers
Prevent double rewards upon app restart or repeated profile visits using the ledger check
Ensure the Roman numeral rank system (I to C) matches existing levels.ts perfectly
